title: 049-N1 · Account statement ignores the credit
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Vera Senn, finance coordinator at Mossline Press. From the case card: two invoice lines have the same shipment, service and date, and the authorised billing team must confirm the duplication and issue a credit note and revised balance.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill

goal: Get the authorised billing team to confirm the duplication on the DL-049 invoice and issue a credit note and a revised balance.

Do not erase either conflicting record or infer a finding before the owner supplies evidence.
